acceptance: A documented decision: either a bounded, evidence-backed parser rule that recovers the 15 columns without altering answer bytes, or a recorded permanent exception with its rationale in the runner's classification
description: The pinned official 17.ans has a merged header/separator field and a wrapped continuation row, so the parser yields 14 columns where SQL returns 15. The runner records an answer error for Q17 on every engine while keeping DataFrame-to-SQL parity. Q17 therefore never contributes printed-answer evidence. Oracle values must not be invented.
